text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love!
Still in Love is in the lead!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Still in Love crosses the line first now!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: "WAAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!"
choice_data_list: Ngh...! She still has that much strength left...?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Ahahahahaha... âª

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: That was... the absolute most delicious thing ever...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: You too!

text_block_list.name: Frustrated Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Damn it...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: You too...♪

text_block_list.name: Terrified Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Hyuh... !?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Still—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I knew it...
You were the most delicious of all!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Hey,
you're going to get even tastier from now on, aren't you?
Man, I seriously can't wai—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
—...!
No... please, hold it in...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
The race... is already over...
So...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Alv-san.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Please forgive my terrible rudeness earlier.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: You've lost your mind, the other you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
“...I suppose... it does look that way, doesn't it?
...It can't be helped.”

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "The more I run against strong opponents, the stronger my 'instincts' become."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Even so... I want strength. I want victory.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I... have to win...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: For the sake of that smile.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: When I run.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: When I achieve victory.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
—They smile at me.
Looking so truly, genuinely happy.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...You'll smile for me...?
In other words, running for that person's sake—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Is that one of the reasons you run?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ..."One of the reasons"...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"That is not the case.
It is the *entire* reason."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
To deliver victory to "that lady" and see her smile.
That is the sole reason I run.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Even if—it means giving myself over
to an uncontrollable impulse.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: You must be joking, right?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Then what about the other you?
Seeking only battles against the strong—"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
To her as well, "that person" is...
the one and only destined soul in this world.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Only my love for "that lady"...
can truly fulfill me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: To deliver victory to someone...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Running for the sake of love... did you say?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Just for something like that...!?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Don't mess with me...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Alv...-san?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"The power of love?! Winning through love?!
How utterly, utterly ridiculous!!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case!
Then I'll...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I will overpower your love...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I will snatch victory away from your love...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I will never lose to strength gained by clinging to someone else!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
—I will win the Shuka Sho.
And after that victory—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"All the strength that supports you—
I will tear it down with my own strength...!"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...I cannot fathom what is in Alv-san's heart.
However..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I have no intention of giving it up...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I am betting everything...
on this "love"!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Not my "racing career," that is.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Staking "my entire existence"...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
If it's for the sake of "that lady's" smile,
I don't care what happens to me—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Groove-san, do you... have something that surpasses such resolve?

On the way back, Admire Groove
had a somewhat tense look on her face.
choice_data_list: Alv, you don't look so good—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose... I cannot lose,
I must not lose...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —Don't follow me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I can... go home on my own.

I hesitated to chase after her.
Because there were no words I could offer.

"Five months until the Shuka Sho.
The weight of 'the final crown' bears down heavily."
